title: Audit CI checks for ruleset
description: Determine if Biblicus repo has CI test action/check name to require in branch ruleset.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Latest Biblicus CI check names: lint, test (3.9), test (3.10), test (3.11), test (3.12), docs, deploy-docs, release. Recommend requiring lint + test matrix, and not requiring release/deploy-docs/docs unless you want docs/publishing gating.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Created ruleset 'main-branch-protection' for refs/heads/main with PR requirement (1 approval, dismiss stale, require last push approval), required status checks: lint, test (3.9), test (3.10), test (3.11), test (3.12); plus block deletions and force pushes. No bypass actors.
